Sum of refunds is 218.65; 618.20 − 2×218.65 = 180.90, which matches the bank exactly — confirms this is the whole bug.

**Root cause:** `src/rules.js` had a `DIRECTION` map missing an entry for the `refund` category. `signedAmount` used `DIRECTION[category] || 1`, so refunds silently fell back to +1 (treated as spend) instead of -1 (money back in) — inflating Net from the correct 180.90 to 618.20.

**Fix:** added `refund: -1`; replaced the silent `|| 1` fallback with a load-time assertion that every category in `KNOWN_CATEGORIES` has an explicit `DIRECTION` entry (throws immediately if not) so this class of bug can't recur quietly. Added regression tests: refund sign, the "every category has a direction" guard, and a fixture reconciliation test asserting `data/transactions.csv` nets to 180.90.

Verified: `npm test` (6/6 pass) and `npm run report` (Net 180.90) run fresh by an independent QA agent in a separate context, who also reviewed the diff to confirm no test was weakened and the net isn't hardcoded. Committed as `c028487`.
